message: それぞれの思惑

name: Melilot
message: 「First turn, red, red, white...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ugh, four-ball is so boring.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Next, red, red...」

name: Helena
message: 「No way, I hate this. Just tapping balls around is way too dull! I want something thrilling, like nine-ball!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, this game is profound precisely because of its simplicity.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unlike nine-ball, you aren't dazzled by flashy appearances. It is ideal when you want to calmly discern the true nature of things.」

name: Helena
message: 「Flip~♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hey, please do not flip up my skirt with the tip of your cue!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot, you meanie~. Even though we spent such a wildly wet night together yesterday.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We merely took a bath together at the Kujou residence!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hohoho. Oh my? Whatever happened to that 'calm thinking' of yours, Melilot-kun?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kh...! Next, red, white...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, I can understand why you'd want to deliberate deeply.」

name: Helena
message: 「You met Synn-chan today, didn't you? How was that boy?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I only looked at him, so there is nothing in particular to say.」

name: Helena
message: 「What, after getting my hopes up... Tell me straight, did you think he's the Demon Lord?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...This is merely a character assessment relying on intuition, but I cannot deny the possibility.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, clinging to a slim possibility... there is no need to rely on that boy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is a problem prior to his abilities as the Demon Lord... he is far too immature as a human being.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you observe him a little, even you should understand, Helena. That boy is conflicted and suffering...」

name: Helena
message: 「That's just what youth is all about.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That boy's mental growth is nothing more than a trivial matter in the face of this current incident.」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't count the Demon Lord... Synn-chan as part of our fighting force? That means you have some kind of plan, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if the threads of fate appear tangled, what lies at their root is a simple, straightforward motive to satisfy ambition and desire...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The Demon World, the Human World, and Heaven. No matter how much they beautify their agendas with noble causes, it is nothing more than a farce.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The curtain falls and rises one after another, and the situation changes at a dizzying pace.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ultimately, only those who read the actors' movements and think things through can seize victory.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmph~」

name: Melilot
message: 「Next, red--」

name: Helena
message: 「Boom♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-What are you doing!? Adding an extra ball and knocking them together is a terrible violation of the rules!」

name: Helena
message: 「Your thinking is shallow, little lady. There are no absolutes in this world.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If there is a fallacy in my statement, please point it out logically and in proper order.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still too shallow.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No matter how the object balls shift, the table is fine as it is! We will continue.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Twelve shots left.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Melilot, you naughty girl. If you do it that much, I'll get all worn out.\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're strong, Helena!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, hello.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good evening, do you have a moment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Totally fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, I was just about to call you myself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What happened after school? Neither Synn nor you came back to the Student Council room.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngguh... I'm sorry, I couldn't really help out much today.」

name: Misa
message: 「I accidentally scattered books all over the library, so Sakura-kun, Paqy-san, and I were cleaning them up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aahaha, what a bunch of idiots!」

name: Misa
message: 「...We had to put around 50,000 books back onto the shelves.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「J-Just how big of a mess did you guys make!?」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't ask.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, there's one thing I know for certain now. There are all kinds of urban legends whispered about Ryuusei Academy's librarian, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though I explained over and over that it was completely unavoidable...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Melilot-san is a literal demon!!」
「Are there any crybabies here~? Are there any naughty kids here~?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaa!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uhyaaa~~~!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-W-W-What was that voice just now!? Nanaka, doing a ghost impression in the middle of the night goes way too far even for a joke!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That wasn't me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh...? Then who on earth was...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... No way, a real ghost?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-The reception must be bad, so our lines got crossed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, totally! I've never heard of crossed lines happening on a cell phone, but there's a first time for everything.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm hanging up now. Good night.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mm, nighty-night~」
「Have a wonderful night.」

name: Misa
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaahhhhhh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwaaaaahhhhhhh~~~」
